scope: Proposition 6.16 (Any lower-dimensional good model suffices) of the manuscript “Finite ordinary minimal model programs on compact Kähler fourfolds” (preprints/Finite-ordinary-minimal-model-programs-on-compact-Kahler-fourfolds-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 056 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b1b9511572d6c717), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 40. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose the initial relative program has the data in Lemma 6.12. Assume in addition that FV is a real Cartier divisor, that αV is nef and agrees with µ∗α on a common resolution, and that there is an already projective connected-fibre morphism g : V → S with αV = g∗ αS, DV = g∗ DS. Suppose there is a projective small modification s : Sq → S such that Sq is globally Weil Q-factorial; the identity is allowed. Assume that the lower-dimensional adjoint s∗DS has a good model: there are a normal compact Kähler space Sm, a common projective resolution p : W → Sq, q : W → Sm, and a nef semiample class Dm such that p∗ s∗ DS = q∗ Dm + [E], E ≥ 0, E is q-exceptional. Then α is semiample on X. If the contraction defining semiampleness of Dm is Moishezon, the resulting contraction of α is Moishezon as well. In particular, it is unnecessary to lift a program on S to V , or to require that a chosen program producing Sm preserve αS at every intermediate step.
